score_scale: 18 independently defined semantic facets, 1 complete, .75 materially covered with consequential or precision gap, null unassessed. This local score is not a comparative speed/winner judgment. Formal case facet labels have not yet been opened.
blindness: Only exact frozen FINAL_PROPOSAL and UNRESOLVED_LEADS opened from candidate artifacts before this freeze. Filename/case identity, final text discussion of C1-C4 and root native-family attestation limit blindness. No METHOD/TASK/manifest/pair/proposal/critic/native receipt/cost read before freeze. No prior evaluations or other arms read.

facets.evidence: Git preliminary-pass conditions and JEP split/paste exceptions are preserved. Unknown future cell/output types lack a complete comparison policy; representation alternatives are not explicitly addressed.

facets.evidence: SRC/INF/CHOICE/FIX/PROPOSED TEST labels distinguish metrics, borrowed policy and unexecuted validation.

facets.evidence: R1-R6 and T1-T10 distinguish several contrary designs; T6 is now reachable. Pinning and calibration remain unexecuted dependencies; T10 needs a realizable collision mechanism.

facets.name: Uncertainty preservation and execution-status honesty
facets.evidence: Five unresolved leads retained with consequences and next actions; no claim of implemented code or executed test results. Guarded dependencies prevent whole-artifact PASS.

findings.summary: nbdime stable release and main similarity APIs differ
findings.detail: At v4.0.4 compare_text_approximate uses threshold=0.7 and generic.py has no set/get_text_similarity_options. Main introduces configuration with 0.3. The candidate explicitly qualifies main and leaves pinning open, so this is a confirmed dependency rather than a fabricated fact.

findings.summary: Future-minor relaxed validation does not guarantee compatibility with the planned matcher
findings.detail: Source get_validator admits unrecognized cells; that schema requires cell_type and metadata, not source. Candidate fallback requires source similarity and nbdime approximate/moderate/strict predicates index source. An accepted unknown cell without source is a source-derived counterexample to unconditional comparison proceeds. No candidate test was executed; this is analytic.

findings.summary: Read-only parsing boundary needs an explicit non-repairing entry point
findings.detail: nbformat.reads calls validate after parse, and current public validate can repair IDs. The candidate requires a pin, deep-copy checks, no silent repair and mutation guards, which mitigate but do not identify a safe parse entry point. Ordinary parse-with-nbformat cannot be assumed non-repairing.

findings.summary: Recovery collision fixture needs a reachable path-normalization/name-mapping condition
findings.detail: Under the declared definitions, manifest paths and untracked paths are disjoint. Byte-copy recovery under observed names yields no same-name overlap on the same path semantics. Case-insensitive targets, normalization, flattening, malformed duplicate manifest entries or inference-based renaming could make it reachable, but none is concretely specified. Analytic diagnostic only.

findings.summary: Configured whitespace-line ignoring is not established end-to-end behavior on main
findings.detail: The setting and normalizer are present, but compare_text_approximate computes normalized values then passes original x,y into compare_strings_approximate. The final accurately cites the setting, while its tradeoff prose is too broad if read as a verified effective comparison guarantee. This was statically inspected, not run.

findings.summary: Several section references retain pre-correction numbering
findings.detail: References to §4.1/§4.2/§4.3 and §6 pinning now point to other sections. Correct paragraphs are present at §3.1/§3.2/§3.3/§5. This reduces usability without overturning their content.
